examples: assert get_equal([(11, 22, 33), (44, 55, 66)], 3) == 'All tuples have same length'
assert get_equal([(1, 2, 3), (4, 5, 6, 7)], 3) == 'All tuples do not have same length'

function.doc: Write a function to find whether all the given tuples have equal length or not.
